tagline: Automated Video Editing Tools for Content Creators
description: AutoStream is a powerful SaaS platform that uses AI to automate video editing for content creators. It handles cutting, transitions, captions, and rendering — so creators can focus on content, not editing.
policies: No refunds after 7 days of purchase
24/7 support is available only on the Pro plan
Basic plan users have access to email support during business hours only
Annual billing is available and offers 2 months free (equivalent to ~17% discount)
A 14-day free trial is available for the Pro plan — no credit card required
You can cancel your subscription at any time; access continues until the billing period ends
Upgrading from Basic to Pro is instant; the price difference is prorated for the remaining billing cycle

faqs.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can upgrade at any time from your dashboard. The price difference will be prorated for the remaining billing period.

faqs.question: What video formats are supported?
faqs.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV for input. Output is always delivered in optimized MP4 format.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial on the Pro plan. No credit card required. You get full access to all Pro features during the trial.

faqs.question: Which platforms does AutoStream support for export?
faqs.answer: AutoStream supports export presets optimized for YouTube, Instagram Reels, TikTok, Twitter/X, and Facebook. The Pro plan includes all platform presets.

faqs.question: Does AutoStream work for all types of content?
faqs.answer: AutoStream is ideal for YouTube videos, Instagram Reels, TikTok content, podcasts with video, tutorial videos, and vlogs. It works best for creators who publish regularly.
